say:1:1320816001:1.text: We heard your cries for help. What happened?
say:1:1320816001:1.source_cn: 我们听到了呼救声，怎么回事？

say:2:1320816002:1.text: Oh, that. It was just a beast that broke into the mine to get away from the snow. It wasn't a real cry for help.
say:2:1320816002:1.source_cn: 呼救？一只闯进矿洞避风雪的野兽而已，我还犯不上为这点事呼救！

say:4:1320816003:1.text: Stop acting cocky! If we didn't show up just now, your throat would've been ripped out!
say:4:1320816003:1.source_cn: 说什么大话！刚才我们不来你就被咬断喉咙了！

say:5:1320816004:1.text: Nah, I could've handled it. My pickaxe and hammer are not to be laughed at!
say:5:1320816004:1.source_cn: 没事！我应付得来！我的铁镐和榔头都很有力量！

say:6:1320816005:1.text: Hey, listen up! No matter what happens, safety is our top priority. Emergency response measures are also included in our work manual. Remember that!
say:6:1320816005:1.source_cn: 无论发生什么，安全比什么都重要！突发情况的应对措施也在...

say:7:1320816006:1.text: Understood... But I still have work I need to finish. It can't be delayed any longer.
say:7:1320816006:1.source_cn: 知道了……但是也不能误工！我还有活儿要干，不能再耽搁了！

say:9:1320816007:1.text: *Sigh*... My people are great at what they do. However, sometimes they are too stubborn.
say:9:1320816007:1.source_cn: 呼……我的同胞们哪里都好，就是有时候太钻牛角尖了。

say:10:1320816008:1.text: It's actually a good thing that you realize this.
say:10:1320816008:1.source_cn: 能意识到别人在钻牛角尖，是件好事！

say:11:1320816009:1.text: Ha! I'll take that as a compliment!

say:12:1320816010:1.text: To be on the safe side, I have to go back and remind my colleagues that there are wild animals in the cave and that they need to pay more attention to their safety.
say:12:1320816010:1.source_cn: 安全起见，我得再回去提醒下其他同胞，洞内有野兽出没，他...
